steps.label: wiring-01-v022
steps.title: OpenRB → ID 1
instructions: Connect OpenRB to ID 1. Align each keyed plug before pushing it straight into the socket.
Check both plugs are seated. Keep a service loop clear of the joint.

steps.label: wiring-02-v022
steps.title: ID 1 → ID 2
instructions: Connect ID 1 to ID 2. Align each keyed plug before pushing it straight into the socket.
Check both plugs are seated. Keep a service loop clear of the joint.

steps.label: wiring-03-v022
steps.title: ID 2 → ID 3
instructions: Seat the plugs at ID 2 and ID 3 after routing the cable through the frame.
Check A → B → C. Keep the wires clear of hole edges and moving joints.
steps.prepareInstruction: With power off, route the free plug through A (entry), B (middle web) and C (exit), then align both plugs.

steps.label: wiring-04-v022
steps.title: ID 3 → ID 4
instructions: Seat the plugs at ID 3 and ID 4 after routing the cable through the frame.
Check A → B → C. Keep the wires clear of hole edges and moving joints.
steps.prepareInstruction: With power off, route the free plug through A (entry), B (middle web) and C (exit), then align both plugs.

steps.label: wiring-05-v022
steps.title: ID 4 → ID 5
instructions: Connect ID 4 to ID 5. Align each keyed plug before pushing it straight into the socket.
Check both plugs are seated. Keep a service loop clear of the joint.

steps.label: wiring-06-v022
steps.title: ID 5 → ID 6
instructions: Connect ID 5 to ID 6. Align each keyed plug before pushing it straight into the socket.
Check both plugs are seated. Keep a service loop clear of the joint.
